common.deniedTitle: You do not have access to this
common.deniedBody: Ask a workspace admin for the "{permission}" permission.

errors.noteRequired: A reason of at least 5 characters is required.
errors.amountInvalid: That amount is not accepted. Use a positive amount with at most 2 decimals.
errors.insufficient: The balance is too low for this.
errors.rateInvalid: A rate could not be saved. Check the country, category and amounts.
errors.importFailed: The rate card could not be read or has no usable row.
errors.syncFailed: Meta's price list could not be read and no bundled card is available.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.subtitle: Your message balance, what you spent and earned in the last 30 days, and how to add money.
wallet.lowBalanceBody: It is at or under {threshold}. Add money to keep your campaigns and replies sending.

kpi.approx: about {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}}

add.title: Add money
add.invalid: Enter a whole amount of 1 or more.

how.title: How billing works

wallet.body: Every delivered message is charged to your wallet at the price for its country and category. Failed messages are not charged.
wallet.funded: When the balance is empty, bulk sends are paused until you add money.

plan.allowance: Your plan includes {limit} messages every month.
plan.extra: Messages beyond the monthly allowance are charged to your wallet.
plan.ended: Your plan has ended, so sending is paused until it is renewed.

how.generic: Your messages are covered by your plan. Your wallet pays for anything the plan does not include.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.emptyBody: Top-ups, message charges and refunds appear here.

pricingPanel.title: Message pricing
pricingPanel.footer: Charged when a message is delivered. The price depends on the recipient's country and the message category.

statement.title: Wallet statement
statement.subtitle: Every movement on your wallet. The totals cover everything that matches the filters, not only this page.
statement.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches these filters. Change or reset them.
statement.emptyNone: Movements on your wallet will be listed here.

filters.rangeInverted: The end date is before the start date.

admin.readOnly: You are signed in as {role}. Only super admins can change wallet settings, prices or balances.

overview.title: Wallet overview
overview.subtitle: The money held in workspace wallets and the last 30 days of movement.

reconcile.title: Check balances against ledgers
reconcile.body: Recomputes every wallet from its ledger and lists any balance that does not match.
reconcile.ok: All {count, plural, one {# wallet matches} other {# wallets match}} their ledger.
reconcile.mismatches: {count} of {checked} wallets do not match their ledger.

pricing.title: Message pricing
pricing.subtitle: What a message costs your customers, how new wallets are protected, and the per-country rate card.

kpi.costHint: Flat price when per-country pricing is off
kpi.spendingHint: Messages that {amount} buys at the flat price

economics.title: Economics
economics.flatPriceHint: At least 0.01. Use the rate grid for free messages.
economics.referralSignupHint: Paid to a referrer on the referee's first paid order.
economics.lowBalanceHint: Workspaces at or under this balance are warned.
economics.coverageHint: A bulk send is refused unless the wallet covers this share of its estimated cost. 0 refuses only an empty wallet.
economics.rewardSentence: A reward of {reward} pays for {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} at the flat price.

problems.invalid: Enter an amount with at most 2 decimals.
problems.percent: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.

perCountryEnabled.label: Per-country pricing
perCountryEnabled.on: On: each message is charged by the recipient's country and category from the rate card.
perCountryEnabled.off: Off: every message is charged the flat price.
perCountryEnabled.confirmOn: Messages will be charged by country and category from the next send.
perCountryEnabled.confirmOff: Messages will be charged the flat price from the next send.

payPerMessage.label: Charge per message
payPerMessage.on: On: workspaces without a plan allowance pay for each delivered message from their wallet.
payPerMessage.off: Off: messages are not charged to wallets.
payPerMessage.confirmOn: Delivered messages will be charged to wallets from now on.
payPerMessage.confirmOff: Wallets will no longer be charged for messages. This affects every workspace.

grid.title: Rate card
grid.modeOn: Per-country pricing is on: these prices are used.
grid.modeOff: Per-country pricing is off: these prices are saved but the flat price is charged.
grid.empty: No rates yet. Add a row, import a rate card or re-seed the starter card.
grid.removeBody: The rate for {country} is deleted. Messages fall back to the next matching rate.
grid.saved: {count, plural, one {# rate saved.} other {# rates saved.}}
grid.savedSome: {saved} saved, {skipped} skipped. See the reason on each skipped row.
grid.unsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved row} other {# unsaved rows}}
grid.tooMany: Too many changed rows for one save. Save in smaller batches.

problems.price: Enter a price with at most 2 decimals.
problems.metaCost: Enter a cost with at most 6 decimals.
problems.country: Use a 2-letter country code, or leave it blank for any country.
problems.empty: Enter a price or a Meta cost.
problems.duplicate: This country and category already has a row.

sync.title: Sync Meta costs
sync.untouched: Your prices are not changed. Only the cost Meta charges you is updated.
sync.bundledNote: No live Meta price list is connected, so the bundled rate card is used.

import.title: Import rate card
import.intro: Upload a CSV rate card. You see what would change before anything is saved.

fileProblems.tooBig: The file is larger than 4 MB.
fileProblems.unreadable: The file could not be read.

import.done: Rate card imported: {added} added, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped.

seed.title: Re-seed the starter rate card?
seed.warning: This writes the bundled starter prices over existing rows for the same country and category. Prices you set by hand for those rows are replaced.
seed.done: {count, plural, one {# rate} other {# rates}} written from the starter card.

crossBorder.title: Cross-border sends
crossBorder.body: The price follows the recipient's country, not the workspace's. Add a row for every country you send to.

how.title: How a price is found
how.body: The wallet looks up the recipient's country and the message category in this card. A blank category or country matches anything.

order.title: Which row wins
order.body: An exact country and category match is used first, then the country with any category, then any country, then the flat price.

workspaces.title: Workspace wallets
workspaces.subtitle: Every workspace with its balance. Open one to see its entries or adjust it.
workspaces.emptyBody: Change the search or clear the low-balance filter.

detail.emptyBody: Movements on this wallet will be listed here.

result.partial: Only {applied} of {requested} was applied because the balance cannot go below 0. The balance is now {balance}.

adjust.title: Adjust balance
adjust.reasonHint: Required, 5 to 500 characters. The workspace sees this reason on its statement.
adjust.cappedWarning: This is more than the balance of {balance}. Only what is there is deducted; the balance stops at 0.
adjust.visibleNote: The reason is shown to the workspace and kept in the audit log.

amount.invalid: Enter a positive amount with at most 2 decimals.
amount.zero: The amount must be greater than 0.
amount.tooLarge: That is above the limit for a single adjustment.

note.short: Say why in at least {min} characters.

logs.title: Wallet logs
logs.subtitle: What happened to wallets and what operators changed.
